# Realsee Skills

Agent skills for panorama reconstruction and editable Blender spaces. Read the selected SKILL.md directly; load its references only for the current task.

## Select a skill

- [argus](.agents/skills/argus/SKILL.md): Submit 1–99 local RGB8 JPEG/PNG/WebP panoramas with exact 2:1 dimensions to Realsee. Returns depth maps, a merged GLB point cloud, camera poses, optional intrinsics, and a validated result index. Requires Node.js 22+, npm 10+, app credentials, and consent to remote upload.
- [realsee-blender-reconstruction](.agents/skills/realsee-blender-reconstruction/SKILL.md): Build or refine an editable native Blender scene from existing scan exports, point clouds, CAD, or panoramas. Requires local Blender and file/command access; local modeling needs no Argus credentials. Argus generation is a separate task.

## Install the selected skill

Current stable distribution: v2.2.0. Select one command; install both only when both capabilities are needed.

```bash
npx skills add realsee-developer/skills@v2.2.0 --skill argus --agent codex
npx skills add realsee-developer/skills@v2.2.0 --skill realsee-blender-reconstruction --agent codex
```

For another host, use the [installation guide](docs/install-guides.md). The Claude plugin includes both skills. The dedicated repository Codex installer and Arkclaw ZIP contain only Argus. From a local checkout, replace the repository source with `.` to install the checked-out skill.

## Check a local checkout

These repository commands inspect the selected skill without installing packages, reading credential values from files, or uploading data. Run Node directly when consuming JSON:

```bash
node scripts/doctor-local.mjs --skill argus --json
node scripts/doctor-local.mjs --skill realsee-blender-reconstruction --json
```

Use `--blender /path/to/blender` when Blender is not on PATH. `status` is `ready`, `needs_configuration`, or `blocked`; each failing or incomplete check includes a next step. This is a local prerequisite check, not proof of service access, input validity, or reconstruction quality. If the skill is already installed without this repository, follow its SKILL.md prerequisite checks instead.

## Execute

- Argus uses explicit `start`, `status`, and `collect` commands with `--json`. Retain the returned `workspace_dir` for later calls. Never automatically resubmit after `submission_unknown`; show `partial` results and all `missing_ids` honestly.
- Blender uses local, task-specific Blender operations. Keep project data outside the installed skill and verify the saved scene's editability before claiming completion.
- File selection and example downloads are not upload consent. Reuse informed consent for the same files and scope. Configure secrets locally; never echo them in chat or logs. Save app credentials only with explicit authorization. See [usage and credential setup](docs/usage.md).

## Repository work only

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before changing this repository. [Development](docs/development.md) describes `setup:local`, rebuilding distributions, and CI; those maintenance steps are not required merely to use a skill. See [Support](SUPPORT.md) for failures and capability access. [简体中文使用指南](docs/zh-CN/usage.md).
